target: LOI (%), RPUF literature benchmark of record: 460 rows / 83 papers
declared: by Opus 5.5, see git commit time; before any run
origin: experiments/critic/loi_round4_critic.md §4 listed systematic polyol-typing errors and said fixing them must be a separate pre-declared round. The fix rules below follow that list; nothing else is changed.

F6_fixed.polyol_type: Assign by the polyol component with the LARGEST stated mass/parts in the row's polyol text; components with 0 g/0 parts ignored; if no amounts, the first-listed component. Per component: polyester_aromatic if /polyester|Stepanpol|PS-?2352|Isoexter|glycoly[sz]ed PET|PET oligo|terephthal/; polyether if /polyether|Rokopol|RF-?551|Voranol|Voracor|LY-?4110|PET-?4110|PTMEG|PPG|PEG|Laprol|oxypropyl|oligoetherol|4110/ (checked BEFORE the bio rule); bio_based if /soy|rapeseed|castor|tung|palm|lignin|canola|bio|HSBP|vegetable/ ; PLA-based -> other_polyester (new level); else unknown. 'heteroaromatic' / 'isocyanurate-based polyether' -> polyether (not aromatic).
F6_fixed.iso_index_num: if the text contains a ratio 'R a:b' or 'a:1', use that ratio; else as round 4
F6_fixed.is_PIR: iso_index_num >= 1.8 OR /PIR|polyisocyanurate/ in polyol/isocyanate/notes, but NOT triggered by 'isocyanurate-based polyether polyol'

candidates.desc: round-4 c2 with F6 replaced by F6_fixed (F7, F8 unchanged)
c1 + loi_standard one-hot {ASTM D2863, GB/T 2406, ISO 4589, other/unknown} by regex on loi_standard + log(density_kgm3)

audit: print the polyol_type assignment for all unique polyol strings (round-4 label vs fixed label) to the log before any model is fit
protocols: identical to the record (B GroupKFold by paper 5x10, repeat-0 paper-bootstrap CI + pooled CI; A random 80/20 x50; C by dominant FR class)
selection_rule: highest B mean; adopt over exp089 only if >= 8/10 paired B repeats better AND B ci_lo >= 0.169; then critic
exit_triggers: B ci_lo > 0.84 or A mean > 0.84 -> EXIT 5
after: LOI extra-round budget exhausted; no further LOI rounds before the lock
